app.name: Sheber
app.tagline: Furniture made to your reference: upload a photo, adjust it in 3D, choose a workshop

hero.title: Furniture like in the photo.
hero.subtitle: Upload a link or a photo and Sheber turns it into a model with a drawing. Adjust the size and finish, and workshops send you their price.

configurator.tryIt: Try it: this is the Sheber configurator

how.label: How it works
how.title: Four steps from a picture to furniture

link.title: A link or a photo
link.text: Paste a product link or upload a photo — even a social media screenshot works.

model.title: Model and drawing
model.text: Sheber builds a model with dimensions. Adjust the width, sections and finish to fit.

publish.title: Order
publish.text: Publish the order — workshops see the drawing and exact sizes right away.

offers.title: Workshop
offers.text: Compare prices, lead times and ratings, and choose who makes your furniture.

audience.label: Who it's for
audience.title: One platform, both sides of the deal

clients.title: Furniture you can't find in stores
clients.text: Made to your size, without endless back-and-forth with makers.
clients.p2: See the model and drawing before ordering
clients.p4: Track the status in one place

workshops.title: Orders you don't have to guess
workshops.text: Ready drawings with dimensions — no eyeballed measurements and no empty calls.
workshops.p1: An order feed from your city
workshops.p2: Drawing and sizes come with the order
workshops.p3: You set the price and lead time
workshops.p4: Your portfolio and rating work for you

sources.title: Any picture is a spec
sources.text: A link, a screenshot or a phone photo.

live.title: 3D before the first cut
live.text: Drag the sizes and the model rebuilds instantly.

compare.title: Prices side by side
compare.text: Workshop offers in a single list.

local.title: Makers nearby
local.text: Workshops in your city, not resellers.

languages.title: Kazakh and Russian
languages.text: The interface speaks both — switch any time.

cta.title: Your furniture already exists — in a photo.
cta.text: Start with one picture. Sheber takes care of the rest: the model, the sizes and the makers.

footer.tagline: Furniture from a photo — from a 3D model to the workshop.

city.notFound: This city is not on the list

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.validation: Check the form: some fields are filled in incorrectly.
errors.not_found: We could not find it. It may have been deleted.
errors.permission_denied: You do not have access to this action.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.profile_incomplete: Add a phone number to your profile so the workshop can reach you.
errors.workshop_required: This is available to verified workshops.
errors.offer_exists: You have already responded to this order.
errors.invalid_status: The order status has changed. Refresh the page.
errors.conflict: The data has changed. Refresh the page.
errors.service_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a minute.
errors.city_not_found: This city is not on the list. Choose another one.

form.url: The link must start with https://

welcome.title: Welcome to Sheber
welcome.text: Let us get to know you. Your phone and city let the chosen workshop contact you and show your orders to workshops nearby.

client.title: I want to order furniture
client.text: I will design it in the constructor and pick a workshop from the offers

workshop.title: I run a workshop
workshop.text: I will take orders. A moderator checks the account after the application

welcome.contactsHint: Only the side you agree a deal with will see them.

profileForm.phoneHint: A Kazakhstan number the workshop will call

projects.title: My projects
projects.description: Furniture you designed in the constructor. Projects save automatically, so you can come back any time.
projects.emptyText: Pick a wardrobe, shelving or dresser template and make it yours.
projects.deleteText: The project will be deleted for good. Published orders stay.

wardrobeHinged.title: Hinged wardrobe
wardrobeHinged.description: Three sections: hanging rail, shelves and drawers, hinged doors

wardrobeSliding.title: Sliding wardrobe
wardrobeSliding.description: Two sliding doors, rails at the sides, drawers in the middle

shelvingOpen.title: Open shelving
shelvingOpen.description: Two columns of four shelves for books and decor

shelvingCabinet.title: Shelving with cabinet
shelvingCabinet.description: Open shelves on top, closed doors below

tvStand.title: TV stand
tvStand.description: Drawers at the sides and an open niche in the middle

start.title: Where do we start?
start.description: Take a template and change everything in it: sizes, sections, contents, doors and materials.
start.templatesText: A template is a starting point. You can rebuild it completely in the constructor.
start.importText: Found furniture in another shop? Soon you will be able to load it straight into the constructor.

link.title: From a shop link
link.text: Soon AI will read the link and build the model itself. For now, pick the type: a similar template opens, and the link is saved with the project so the workshop sees the sample.

photo.title: From a photo
photo.text: Take a photo of furniture or upload a screenshot, and AI will work out its type, proportions and materials.

steps.one: Upload a photo or a screenshot
steps.three: You adjust the sizes in the constructor

editor.title: Project name
editor.notFoundText: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.

view.label: View
view.hint3d: Tap a section to edit it. Rotate the model with a finger or the mouse
view.hintDrawing: Tap a section to edit it

facade.openHint: No doors: everything inside is on view. Drawers get their own fronts.
facade.hingedHint: Doors belong to sections: choose a section and set which way its door opens.
facade.slidingHint: Sliding doors cover the whole front. Drawers behind them become internal.

section.name: Section {{index}}
section.emptyText: Tap any part of the furniture on the model or the drawing to see its settings here.
section.autoHint: The section takes the space left by sections with an exact size.
section.divideHint: The section splits into two parts with the same contents. You can then set each one up separately.

door.covered: The door of "{{name}}" already covers this section.

check.title: Design check
check.ok: All good: no errors or warnings.
check.hint: Errors block publishing. Warnings can stay; the workshop takes them into account.

issues.splitOverflow: The exact part sizes do not fit. Reduce them or set one part to Auto.
issues.cellTooSmall: The section is too small: it needs at least {{width}} × {{height}} mm.
issues.shelfTooLong: A shelf longer than {{max}} mm may sag. Add a divider.
issues.shelvesTooDense: The shelves are too close: leave at least {{min}} mm between them.
issues.rodTooLow: Not enough height for a rail: clothes need at least {{min}} mm.
issues.rodTooLong: A rail longer than {{max}} mm may bend.
issues.drawerTooNarrow: A drawer narrower than {{min}} mm leaves no room for runners.
issues.drawerTooWide: A drawer wider than {{max}} mm will skew when pulled out.
issues.drawerTooLow: Drawers lower than {{min}} mm are impractical. Use fewer of them.
issues.doorTooWide: A door leaf wider than {{max}} mm is heavy. A double door works better.
issues.doorTooNarrow: A door leaf narrower than {{min}} mm leaves no room for hinges.
issues.slidingTooNarrow: A sliding door narrower than {{min}} mm is too small. Use fewer doors.
issues.slidingTooWide: A sliding door wider than {{max}} mm is hard to move. Add a door.
issues.slidingTooShallow: Sliding doors need a depth of at least {{min}} mm: the tracks take part of it.

publish.title: Publish the order
publish.description: Workshops in your city will see the model with its sizes and offer a price and a time frame. Only the workshop you choose gets your contacts.
publish.notesHint: Hardware, edge colour, delivery and assembly: anything the model does not show.
publish.notesPlaceholder: For example: soft-close doors, assembly on the 4th floor
publish.success: The order is published. Workshops can see it now
publish.blockedText: Fix the errors on the Check tab: a workshop cannot make the furniture with them.

orders.title: My orders
orders.description: Published projects and the offers workshops sent for them.
orders.emptyText: Design a project in the constructor and publish it. Workshops will send prices and time frames.

published.title: Published
published.text: Workshops send offers with a price and a time frame

assigned.title: Workshop chosen
assigned.text: Contacts are open, so discuss the details

in_progress.title: In progress
in_progress.text: The workshop is making the furniture

orderActions.completeText: Mark it once the furniture is made and you have received it.
orderActions.cancelText: The order leaves the workshops' feed, and pending offers close.

orderPage.notFoundText: It was deleted or has gone to another workshop.
orderPage.noOffersYet: No offers yet. Workshops in your city can already see the order.
orderPage.closed: The order no longer accepts offers.

offer.commentHint: Materials, hardware and what the price includes: delivery, assembly.
offer.sent: The offer was sent to the client
offer.withdrawText: The client will no longer see your offer. You can respond again later.
offer.acceptText: Other offers close, and you and the workshop see each other's contacts.

market.title: Order feed
market.description: Client projects with a model and sizes. Respond to the ones you can make.
market.emptyText: Try another city or furniture type. New orders appear here as soon as they are published.
market.lockedText: Fill in the workshop application. Client orders appear here once it is verified.

myOffers.title: My offers
myOffers.description: Your workshop's offers and what clients decided.
myOffers.emptyText: Find a suitable order in the feed and offer a price and a time frame.

workshop.applyText: Tell us about your workshop. A moderator checks the details, and then the order feed opens for you.

pending.title: Application under review
pending.text: The review usually takes up to one working day. You can still update the application.

approved.title: Workshop verified
approved.text: Respond to orders: clients see your prices and time frames.

rejected.title: Application rejected
rejected.text: Fix the details and send the application again.

form.name: Workshop name
form.taxIdHint: 12 digits. It lets clients work with real workshops
form.websiteHint: Optional, but a portfolio helps you win orders
form.descriptionHint: Experience, materials, equipment, delivery and assembly.
form.sent: The application was sent for review

why.one: Clients share their projects and contacts only with real workshops.
why.two: A verified workshop sees every order in its city.
why.three: No spam: every offer comes from a verified maker.

moderation.title: Workshop moderation
moderation.description: Check the company details and portfolio. Approval gives the workshop access to the order feed.
moderation.rejectText: The workshop owner will see the reason. They can fix the application and send it again.
moderation.emptyText: There are no applications with this status.
